text:
support-ops: FYI ParcelPro just escalated — multiple customers seeing 429s and big latency spikes on their Dedicated pool for the last ~30m. They also reported some auth 401s interleaved with retries. Paging eng-sre. :eyes:

nishant: copying logs from the customer — looks like a cycle of retries -> brief throughput surge -> scale-down -> more retries. Autoscaler target size keeps toggling between 6 and 3.

support-ops: exact tenant id: parcelpro-92. They included a curl repro that consistently triggers a retry flood when token refreshes coincide with higher tail latency.

sam: can you paste the autoscaler event log? curious if cooldowns are too short or if there are misdetected health checks.

support-ops: pasted below (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-17T15:02:10Z] target=6 reason=scale_up load=0.78
[2026-03-17T15:04:08Z] target=3 reason=scale_down load=0.22
[2026-03-17T15:05:55Z] target=6 reason=scale_up load=0.85
[2026-03-17T15:07:01Z] target=3 reason=scale_down load=0.18
```

elaine: that looks like the quick success/fail flip. current config: scale_down_cooldown=60s, scale_up_cooldown=20s, min_replicas=2, max_replicas=12. If scale_down_cooldown is 60s we can still oscillate if brief spikes push us above the up threshold after the scale_down completes.

kat: also seeing auth errors in the same timeframe: some refresh token calls to our auth service return 502, client retries 3x with exponential backoff ~500ms-2s which feeds the traffic burst. So root cause might be auth instability + aggressive downscaling.

nishant: metric snapshot (percentiles):
```
p95 latency before spike = 120ms
p95 during spike = 1.4s
request rate per-node = 45r/s -> 160r/s during retry-burst
GPU util per node = 12% -> 68% during burst
```

sam: ok this is classic noisy-tenant amplified by low cool-down + retry storms. Two-pronged approach: 1) throttle per-tenant burst (short term) 2) increase scale_down_cooldown and stabilize scale thresholds (medium term).

dev-support: any quick mitigations we can run now? ParcelPro is on Dedicated EU-west pool - they want an immediate fix.

elaine: temp mitigation steps I can do now: set scale_down_cooldown=300s, increase down_threshold from 0.25 -> 0.35, enable tenant burst-protection for parcelpro-92. Should reduce flip-flopping.

sam: sounds good. Also can we patch auth retry logic to add jitter + longer backoff for 5xx from auth? That will reduce synchronized retries.

kat: billing note: we saw a correlated billing meter spike at 15:05-15:08 — auto-scaling churn caused short-lived extra replicas charged; customer flagged cost anomalies. We should estimate the delta and include in postmortem.

nishant: repro steps for eng-runtime:
1) start a background token-refresh worker that fails auth 50% of the time for 30s
2) send steady 40r/s per-client for 3 clients in the tenant
3) observe autoscaler toggles and 429s when pool shrinks

support-ops: ParcelPro confirmed workaround works when we enabled tenant burst-protection. They still want permanent fix.

sam: action items:
- elaine: roll temp config to parcelpro's pool and monitor for 1h (owner)
- nishant + sam: run repro in staging and test new cooldown values (300s, 600s) and new down_thresholds; capture stability metrics (owner)
- dev-support: assess auth retry patches and coordinate with auth team (owner)
- kat: calculate billing delta and communicate to CS (owner)
- ops-bot: create INC and link to ticketing

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-892 created and assigned to eng-sre oncall.

elaine: rolled scale_down_cooldown=300s and tenant burst-protection for parcelpro-92 at 15:15 UTC. Initial telemetry: no further 429s in last 8m, p95 back down to ~150ms. :thumbsup:

sam: great. We'll follow up w/ a short postmortem and a proposal to add tenant-aware cooldowns and hard per-tenant rate caps to avoid future noisy neighbor amplification.

dev-support: thanks team — leaving notes on the customer ticket with steps and ETA for permanent change.

support-ops: ParcelPro updated CS: appreciated quick mitigation, asked for root cause writeup and billing reconciliation.

nishant: logging reminder — add tenant id to autoscaler events and keep last_failed_auth_count in metrics so it's easier to correlate in future.

sam: agreed. closing thread to track work in INC and a followup doc.
